Lessons.Title: Estimating Proportions from Samples
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Calculate the margin of error for a population proportion estimate. Use data from a random sample to determine an estimate for a population proportion.

For a sufficiently large simple random sample, an approximate 95% margin of error for sample proportion p is about 2 sqrt(p(1-p)/n). The conservative worst-case p=.5 gives approximately1/sqrt(n). Conditions and clustering matter.
